name: scicode-native-validator-extension
description: Chrome extension package using local Python native messaging backend

scripts.pack: powershell -NoProfile -Command "if (Test-Path dist) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force dist }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path dist | Out-Null; Compress-Archive -Path manifest.json,popup.html,popup.js,styles.css,README.md -DestinationPath dist/scicode-native-validator-extension.zip -Force"
